display.purpose: Today prompt over the note field.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default state transitions, sheen, ambient drift.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Ambient light fields. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Default glass pill with hover sheen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Liquid accent pill for the one main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#0E7380 70%,#fff);background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,#0E7380 78%,#fff) 0%,#0E7380 55%,color-mix(in srgb,#0E7380 88%,#000) 100%);box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55) inset,0 -2px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12) inset,0 12px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb,#0E7380 80%,transparent);color:#fff;font:600 15px 'Funnel Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.965)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid #0E7380;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Inset frosted field with soft accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input{width:100%;min-height:46px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(20,50,58,0.10);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.62);box-shadow:0 2px 6px -2px rgba(20,50,58,0.12) inset,0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9);color:#14323A;font:400 16.5px 'Funnel Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;caret-color:#0E7380;transition:box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 220ms}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(63,184,201,0.22),0 2px 6px -2px rgba(20,50,58,0.12) inset}

components.name: Capsule States
components.description: Filled counted, hollow ring unsure, struck rejected.
components.html: Fatigue Joint pain Fever
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 14px;border-radius:999px;font:500 15px 'Funnel Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;color:#14323A;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.85);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0.9),rgba(255,255,255,0.62));box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 #fff inset,0 6px 12px -10px rgba(20,50,58,0.55)}.ds-chip-filled{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,#3FB8C9 55%,#fff);background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,#3FB8C9 34%,#fff),color-mix(in srgb,#3FB8C9 22%,#fff))}.ds-chip-review{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,#14323A 50%,transparent);box-shadow:none}.ds-chip-struck{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:color-mix(in srgb,#A23B52 70%,transparent);color:#45616A;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.35)}

components.name: Day Compartment
components.description: One of seven candy-plastic lids with hinge, specular streak and latch.
components.css: .ds-comp{--c:#3FB8C9;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;width:110px;min-height:116px;padding:16px 6px;border-radius:22px;color:#14323A;font:600 13px 'Funnel Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 60%,rgba(255,255,255,0.9));background:radial-gradient(120% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0.6),rgba(255,255,255,0) 62%),linear-gradient(175deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 42%,transparent) 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 62%,transparent) 72%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 52%,transparent) 100%);box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95) inset,0 -10px 18px -10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 80%,#000) inset,0 16px 26px -14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 75%,transparent);transition:transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)}.ds-comp b{font-size:30px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.03em}.ds-comp::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-5px;left:50%;width:38%;height:8px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6fafb,#c3d2d7);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,50,58,0.25)}.ds-comp::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:7px;left:14%;right:14%;height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,0.95),rgba(255,255,255,0))}.ds-latch{position:absolute;bottom:-4px;left:50%;width:22%;height:7px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 70%,#fff);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 60%,#fff);border-top:0}.ds-comp:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.ds-comp:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid #0E7380;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: Clario is a translucent Y2K seven-day organizer in liquid glass. The week is always visible as seven candy-plastic compartments; the chosen day swells open and joins a large glass tray below. The ground is icy and lit by three slow colour fields. Both apps share this one light world: the patient app leads with aqua, the clinic console with lilac. Calm and precise, desktop-first, never the stock health-app white card.
keyCharacteristics: Icy ground with per-app ambient light (patient aqua-led, clinic lilac-led).
Frosted glass for large surfaces; gradient-faked glass for small controls.
Seven compartments cycling aqua, lilac, coral; the selected one turns clear glass and joins the tray.
Fixed capsule state marks: filled, hollow ring, struck.
One liquid indicator (shared-layout glide) for nav and selected day.
Deep teal ink (indigo ink in the clinic), AA contrast on ice and on glass.

rules.name: The Ambient Light Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from three blurred fields behind the glass, not from flat fills on panels. The fields drift on transform only.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Aqua leads in the patient app, lilac in the clinic. Switch with data-app, never by recolouring components.

rules.name: The Candy Is Material Rule
rules.body: Aqua, lilac and coral colour surfaces. Text always uses ink, muted, or the deep accent.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Dates, counts and tables use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Codes Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only on identifiers, never on prose or labels.

rules.name: The Large Surfaces Only Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter is allowed only on large surfaces. Small controls fake glass with white gradients.

rules.name: The Soft Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows are long, negative-spread and ink-tinted. No hard-edged or coloured offset shadows.

dos: Do keep state marks fixed: filled is confirmed, hollow ring is unsure, struck is rejected.
Do put colour in ambient light and compartments; keep panels near-white glass.
Do use ease-out (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) or ease-liquid (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for transitions, and framer-motion springs only for the nav indicator and selected-day neck.
Do animate ambient drift on transform only, and stop all animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep text on ink, muted, or the deep accent so it holds 4.5:1.
Do keep copy free of em dashes and exclamation marks.
donts: Don't put backdrop-filter on chips, buttons, or list items.
Don't use candy aqua, lilac or coral as text colour.
Don't use the stock health-app look of flat white cards on grey.
Don't use Geist Mono for anything but codes and fingerprints.
Don't blend patient aqua and clinic lilac leads on one screen; the root data-app decides.
